name: Кустовой дуб
subject: A LOW spreading shrubby oak with THREE short dark-brown stems branching immediately above the bottom, a wide irregular cluster of FOUR low chunky green foliage lobes. Bush height shorter than foliage width, forest-green leaf blocks with broad warm olive patches, a few visible brown branch joints. No long tree trunk, decorative pot, soil, stones, grass bed or ground; open white background under cut-off stems. Detailed coarse stepped voxel surfaces with connected leaf masses, same stem/canopy construction across five views.
caption: Отдельный вариант дуба: пять ракурсов на белом фоне; без земли, площадки и ландшафта.
